Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing assumptions of water-sewer districts by code cities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assumption by a code city with a populationgreater than one hundred thousand of a watersewer district with fewerthan two hundred fifty customers; adding a new section to chapter35.13A RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The board of commissioners of a watersewer district, withfewer than two hundred fifty customers on the effective date of thisact, and the city council of a code city with a population greater thanone hundred thousand on the effective date of this act, may provide forassumption by the city of the district in accordance with RCW35.13A.020, except as provided herein, pursuant to the terms andconditions of a contract executed in accordance with RCW 35.13A.070.None of the territory of the watersewer district need be includedwithin the territory of the city. The contract and assumption shall beapproved by resolution of the board of commissioners and ordinance ofthe city council. If the watersewer district has no indebtedness ormonetary obligations on the date of assumption, the city shall use any p. 1 SB 6661surplus funds only for water services delivered to and water facilitiesconstructed in the former territory of the district, unless providedotherwise in the contract. In connection with the assumption, thewatersewer district or the city, or both, may provide for dissolutionof the district pursuant to RCW 35.13A.080. (2) This section expires December 31, 2006.
